videos.title: Sam's Garage
videos.description: Former "Shadetree Mechanic" and "Two Guys Garage" host Sam Memmolo, a pioneer in automotive how-to TV, is back turning wrenches and tightening bolts on "Sam's Garage." Memmolo helped develop the concept of step-by-step instructions to help advise viewers of the latest products and techniques for repairing and improving a wide variety of rides, a legacy that continues on his latest series. With vast automotive knowledge in the garage and in the studio, Memmolo is as entertaining as he is experienced.

videos.title: Animal Rescue
videos.description: Just about everybody likes animals and doesn't like to see animals who are sick, injured or abused. So "Animal Rescue," a weekly series -- aimed at children and families -- that showcases spectacular rescues of animals, should be very popular. Because people don't like to see an animal's situation get so bad that it requires rescue, the program tries to avoid those situations by instructing children on the proper care of animals, as well as giving safety tips on caring for all types of creatures.

videos.title: Dog Tales
videos.description: Dogs are said to be man's best friend so is it a surprise that there's a weekly show dedicated to dogs and the people who love them? That's what "Dog Tales" is all about. The show, aimed at teenagers, features information on dogs of all shapes, sizes and breeds while also informing young people on how to properly care for pets. It also provides safety, health and training tips that are useful for different breeds of dogs as well as emphasizing responsible pet ownership and compassion for all living creatures.
